$comment: Completion bar for #44: src/App.tsx held the Ask home, notes rail, note peek, chat and settings in one 2,781-line component with ~20 effects. The split extracts the pure helpers/constants/types into src/domain.ts, each UI feature into its own presentational component under src/features/ (TopBar, NotesRail, FindPanel, ChatView, PromptsView, NotePeek, AiSettingsDialog, ContentChrome), and the state-owning logic into hooks under src/hooks/ (useUi, useProviders, useNotes, usePrompts, useChat). App.tsx is left as a thin orchestrator that composes them. A renderer test suite (vitest + Testing Library, tests/renderer/) mounts the components and hooks, so the split is verified rather than only compiling. Criteria 1-14 fail before the split (the files do not exist); 15 asserts App.tsx actually shrank below 500 lines (it was 2,783); 16 guards the renderer test suite; 17-18 guard the renderer typecheck and build (the CI gates).

amendments.reason: The first bar declared only the component split (features + domain) and a <1300-line App.tsx. The issue's fix direction also names hooks, so the bar is extended to require the state extraction into src/hooks/* and tightened to require App.tsx below 500 lines, now that the orchestrator is fully split.

Codecov's patch gate (70%) failed on the renderer-only refactor because no test mounted the renderer. A vitest + Testing Library suite (tests/renderer/) now mounts the components and hooks, so the bar requires the renderer tests to pass instead of relying on a manual npm run dev check.
